canonical_hierarchy.surface_definition: A valid observed surface pixel not labeled as cloud or shadow. It is not restricted to clear-sky land and may have dataset-native children such as water or snow.
canonical_hierarchy.probability_rule: Each native leaf belongs to exactly one parent. Parent probability is the sum of its dataset-native leaf probabilities, or is constructed directly and multiplied by conditional child probabilities.
canonical_hierarchy.forbidden_shortcut: Do not silently relabel snow, water, flooded, fill, or nodata as clear-sky land.
